known_issues: Known history of hub-side denial-of-service conditions affecting availability.
Ecosystem-facing hub components should be kept updated because central failure affects all attached devices.
recommendation: Review hub firmware version and apply vendor updates.
Restrict unnecessary exposure of hub management interfaces.
Confirm cloud and local bridge access settings are still appropriate.

known_issues: Known history of authentication bypass and HTTP-facing vulnerabilities in SmartThings-related components.
Hub and ecosystem components may expose elevated risk when management or camera-related features are reachable.
recommendation: Review SmartThings hub and ecosystem software versions.
Restrict administrative and camera-related interfaces where possible.
Confirm that all SmartThings components remain supported and updated.

known_issues: Known issues have affected Tuya ecosystem SDK and Smart Life account-linking flows.
Controller or app-layer weaknesses can impact multiple attached devices across the ecosystem.
recommendation: Review app, SDK, and controller software update status.
Check account-linking and third-party integration settings.
Prefer the latest vendor-supported versions across the ecosystem.
